```lean
theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  let k' := k
  have h_field : IsField k' := Subfield.isField k'
  have h_alg : IsAlgebraic ℚ k' := Subfield.isAlgebraic k'
  exact Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans (Algebra.isAlgebraic_subfield k') (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isAlgebraic h_alg)
```
